title: 보건소에서 독감 주사 맞기: 다 쓰고 나서 어디로 가요?
objective: You can use -고 나서 / -고 나면 to ask and talk about what comes next.
summary: Learners follow a flu shot visit and practice talking about what comes next.
setting: A public health center (보건소). Mina comes in for a flu shot. Grammar focus: -고 나서 / -고 나면 (after doing A, then B).

task.title: Use the steps and words
task.line: Read the dialogue again, then do each task: fill in blanks, combine sentences, choose words, find information, and put steps in order.

words.exampleMeaning: I forgot the date of my child's vaccination.

words.meaning: health screening form you fill out before a shot
words.example: 예진표에 지금 먹는 약을 적어 주세요.
words.exampleMeaning: Please write the medicine you are taking now on the screening form.
You have to fill out this document in pen.

words.example: 신분증을 안 가져와서 집에 다시 갔어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I didn't bring my ID, so I went back home.

words.meaning: the spot where the shot was given
words.exampleMeaning: The spot where I got the shot turned a little red.

words.meaning: bad reaction (side effect after a shot)
words.example: 이상 반응이 생기면 바로 병원에 가세요.
words.exampleMeaning: If you get a bad reaction, go to a hospital right away.

dialogue.meaning: I came to get a flu shot.

dialogue.korean: 신분증 주시고, 이 예진표를 먼저 작성해 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Please give me your ID and fill out this screening form first.
Where do I go after I finish it?
When you're done, wait in front of Exam Room 2.

dialogue.korean: 주사를 맞고 나서 20분쯤 여기 앉아서 쉬다가 가세요.
dialogue.meaning: After the shot, sit and rest here for about 20 minutes before you leave.

dialogue.korean: 접종 부위는 문지르지 마시고, 이상 반응이 있으면 연락 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Don't rub the spot where you got the shot, and call us if you have any bad reaction.

exercises: Fill in the blanks with -고 나서 (use the word in brackets): ① 손을 ____ 밥을 먹어요. (씻다) ② 이 영화를 ____ 그 배우를 좋아하게 됐어요. (보다)
Make one sentence with -고 나면: 이 약을 먹다 / 좀 괜찮아질 거예요.
Choose the right word: ① 접종 (부위 / 반응)를 세게 누르지 마세요. ② 어제 주사를 맞고 팔이 많이 부었어요. (이상 반응 / 예진표)인 것 같아요.
Find the answer in the dialogue and write it in Korean: Where should Mina wait after she fills out the form?
Put the steps in the order they happen in the dialogue: ① 주사를 맞아요. ② 예진표를 작성해요. ③ 20분쯤 앉아서 쉬어요. ④ 신분증을 내요.
answers: ① 씻고 나서 ② 보고 나서
이 약을 먹고 나면 좀 괜찮아질 거예요.
